moments.cue: The Airbus lost both engines at 2,800 feet, forcing a glide into the Hudson.
The Airbus A320 struck the geese 2,800 feet above the runway, shutting down both engines.
Captain Sully Sullenberger turned the aircraft toward the Hudson, refusing a return to LaGuardia.
The plane impacted the river at a calibrated airspeed of 125 knots.
